name: GitHub Enterprise (IBM)
tagline: IBM's internal GitHub Enterprise REST API, authenticated with a personal access token.
description: IBM's GitHub Enterprise instance exposes a REST API at github.ibm.com/api/v3. Authenticate with a personal access token created on github.ibm.com.

methods.label: Personal access token
methods.note: Create a PAT on your IBM GitHub Enterprise instance and pass it as a Bearer token.

auth.guide:
**Personal access token:** create one under [Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens](https://github.ibm.com/settings/tokens) on your IBM GitHub Enterprise instance.

Use it with the REST API:

```bash
curl https://github.ibm.com/api/v3/user -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_IBM_TOKEN"
```

sources.title: GitHub Enterprise Server — creating a personal access token
